description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ShareAccountsNotFoundException' used within the share products portfolio of the Fineract platform, indicating that no share accounts were found for a given product ID.

classes.name: ShareAccountsNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that share accounts for a specific product ID are not found, extending the platform's resource not found exception.

methods.name: ShareAccountsNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with an error message key, a detailed message including the product ID, and the product ID itself.
